subject: Mitigations as basis for tier upgrade and renewal terms
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha@fintrack.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: DevOps Team <ops@fintrack.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reliability incidents & upcoming renewal - immediate mitigation ask

Marcus,

Thanks for the chat earlier. I promised to summarize the outstanding reliability concerns we've seen over the last 3 months and what FinTrack needs ahead of our Nov renewal to feel comfortable expanding usage. Key points: 

- Multiple tail-latency spikes in Aug/Sep impacting real-time scoring (see attached incident timeline).
- We need a formal remediation plan, with measurable SLOs, and a short-term credit/compensation for customer impact.
- We're evaluating a larger commitment if Redwood can provide a dedicated pilot (priority routing + upgraded latency objective) and explicit rollback controls.

Can you share a mitigation plan + indicative pricing for a 3-month dedicated pilot and what the SLA amendment would look like? We need something to present to Procurement next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Park
Head of Engineering, FinTrack Analytics
Samantha.Park@fintrack.com

Attachment: fintrack_incident_timeline.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@fintrack.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reliability incidents & upcoming renewal - immediate mitigation ask

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear summary and the timeline. I’m sorry FinTrack has been hit by the tail-latency issues; we take this seriously. Quick response and proposed next steps: 

1) Immediate: enable request-level routing to our low-latency pool for your production routes (no code changes) and turn on prefix KV cache for the scoring models — expect median p50 improvements within 24 hours.

2) Pilot: offer a 90-day "Priority Pilot" (dedicated capacity reservation + improved network egress paths) with a targeted p95 latency SLO of 350ms for scoring endpoints.

3) Compensation: propose a one-time incident credit of 10% of August+September usage if we do not meet the p95 target during the pilot month.

4) Contract change: we can draft a one-page SLA amendment that adds the p95 SLO, reporting cadence, and a rollback clause to transition you back to the current tier within 48 hours if the pilot doesn't meet expectations.

I’ve looped in Laura from Solutions to help with the pricing/ops side. I’ll follow up by EOD tomorrow with a draft amendment and a pricing snapshot for the 90-day pilot.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinTrack renewal — pricing + SLA amendment ask

Laura / Marissa —

Copy of the ask from FinTrack (below). They want: 90-day dedicated pilot, p95 350ms SLO, incident credit if SLO missed, and a quick rollback clause. Renewal is Nov. They’ll consider expanding if the pilot succeeds. 

Questions: 
- Can we meet p95=350ms in the proposed pilot configuration on our standard L2 dedicated nodes? Any risk that we can't reasonably commit to that SLO?
- What pricing should I show for a 90-day reserved pilot (target: 60% uplift over hosted pricing) while keeping the economics acceptable — keep sanity for an expansion motion.
- Legal: can we add a rollback clause that allows FinTrack to revert to their prior plan within 48 hours without penalty? How does that affect billing?

I’ve attached the incident timeline and a first-pass amendment (proposed_sla_amendment_v1.docx). Need ops + solutions numbers by EOD tomorrow so I can send the buyer-facing doc.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachment: proposed_sla_amendment_v1.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: FinTrack renewal — pricing + SLA amendment ask

Marcus —

Quick answers: 

- Tech: Solutions confirms the pilot (dedicated L2 + optimized kernels + IPVLAN egress) can reliably hit p95=350ms for their median load profile, with a caveat — sustained burst traffic above 4x their current QPS risks higher tail latency unless we enable autoscale headroom. Recommend we include autoscale headroom of +25% in the pilot.

- Pricing: For a 90-day reserved pilot, recommend a 55% uplift over their current hosted spend (we can get to 60% if they want exclusive nodes). The 55% plan gives us margin and keeps the ask attractive.

- Rollback & billing: Legal ops suggests a rollback clause that allows transition back to hosted within 48 hours; billing for the month of rollback will be pro-rated to usage at the tier they fall back to and any reserved capacity fee will be refunded pro-rata minus a 10% administrative fee. That's acceptable to Procurement but we should present it transparently.

I’ll join the call with Samantha next Tuesday if you want.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Park <samantha@fintrack.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fintrack.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reliability incidents & upcoming renewal - immediate mitigation ask

Samantha —

Thanks — attached is a buyer-facing one-pager and the draft SLA amendment that reflects the items we discussed: 

- 90-day Priority Pilot (dedicated L2 capacity) with autoscale headroom +25%
- p95 latency objective: 350ms for scoring endpoints (measured weekly; reporting dashboard included)
- Incident credit: 10% of the two-month prior spend if p95 missed in any pilot month
- Rollback: 48-hour rollback to prior tier; reserved fee refunded pro-rata less 10% admin fee

Link to the draft (read-only): https://docs.redwood.ai/sla/amendments/FT-2026-042
DocuSign link (for quick sign): https://docusign.com/FT-2026-042/sla-amendment

If this looks good, we’ll:
1) Enable the low-latency routing and KV prefix cache today (no code changes on your side).
2) Schedule a kickoff to stand up the pilot (Ops + FinTrack DevOps).
3) Execute the SLA amendment and start pilot billing on the first day of pilot.

Would you like Laura and me on the procurement call tomorrow at 11am PT?

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: proposed_sla_amendment_v1.docx, fintrack_incident_timeline.pdf
